alt_text: A cream and sage-green handwritten portrait poster for RESCENE Deja Vu. Three tilted MV stills show a girl resting her face on her hand, a girl holding a dandelion in a field, and a girl standing beside a moving orange train. Korean lyric excerpts and small English translations connect breeze, scent, dream and recurring memory.
